== Session data saved reliably during high load

Session updates are no longer delayed or lost when new database connections are slow to open. Previously, while many sessions ran at the same time, some session updates could fail and not be saved.

* Session state, session videos, and test reports are saved reliably while many sessions run at the same time.
* A database connection that stops responding while opening is now abandoned and retried, so it no longer blocks session updates.
